ns2:course.label: School Social Work Practice
ns2:course.description: Examination of the design and delivery of school social work interventions with special emphasis given to students with physical/mental disabilities and vulnerable populations. Course content provides a foundation for the development of a comprehensive and in-depth understanding of an ecological systems approach to social work practice based upon a foundation of professional values and ethics. Prerequisite: SOCW 400.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MSW:Social Work -UIUC.
